- The root cause is in `damagedItemFor`, which resolves each damage independently with `find`, so N damage entries of one type all map to the same single insured item:

```ts
const damagedItemFor = (damage: Damage, policyItems: Item[]): Item => {
  const damagedItem = policyItems.find((item) => item.type === damage.itemType);
  ...
};
```

The fix must count damage entries per item type against the number of insured items of that type, and throw when the count exceeds it — while keeping the existing green test at lines 1160-1201 (two insured swords, two sword damage entries → `{ payout: 600, remainingCap: 3400 }`) passing.
